helpTopics.a: Choose class and section, then mark each student Present or Absent. Review the roster and confirm the demo submission.
Choose class, section, subject and enter a test name. Add marks and optional remarks for each student, then review the result set.

helpTopics.q: How to scan an answer copy?
helpTopics.a: Keep the camera open and capture pages in order. Pages are added automatically; generate a PDF, review the page images, then attach the file to the result draft.
Open See Previous Results from Home and select a result set to view averages, high/low scores and student rankings.
Open Profile, choose Edit Profile and update your contact, qualification or profile information. This demo stores edits only in app memory.
Enter current password, new password and confirmation. Password changes are not connected until a real authentication service is integrated.
In a real release, contact school IT support. This UI prototype has no live helpdesk or server.

termsSections.title: Use of the App
termsSections.body: This teacher app is intended for authorized school staff. Keep student information confidential and use it only for school responsibilities.

termsSections.title: Student Data
termsSections.body: Access student records only when required for assigned work. Do not export or share them through unauthorized channels.

termsSections.title: Acceptable Use
termsSections.body: Do not share your login credentials or leave the app accessible on a shared device.

termsSections.title: Demo Notice
termsSections.body: The current prototype stores drafts only in memory. No record, password or scanned copy is sent to a server.

privacySections.title: Information We Use
privacySections.body: The production application may process teacher profile information, attendance and assessment records required for school operations.

privacySections.title: Data Security
privacySections.body: Access control, encryption, audit trails and retention rules must be implemented and reviewed before production use.

privacySections.title: Camera and Files
privacySections.body: The scanner requires camera access to capture answer-sheet pages. Captured files remain local in this demo.

privacySections.title: Demo Privacy Notice
privacySections.body: This prototype uses fictional records. Do not capture real students or enter personal information during testing.
